page: Amazon Web Services x2iedn.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 64 vCPUs and 32 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 2048.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 32.0 GB per core. Local storage is provided via a 1900 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and the instance supports a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and specialized execution capabilities. The instance achieves a strong rating in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance with a score of 61947.26 and a strong PassMark CPU score of 56826.42. While single-core performance in stress-ng and Geekbench is average, multi-threaded tasks like software compilation with Clang and PassMark database operations rank in the top 25% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth tests show average performance, with read-only large block speeds at 153.34 GB/sec and write large block speeds at 61.06 GB/sec.

The high memory density of 32.0 GB per vCPU makes this instance class qualitatively efficient for memory-bound workloads, reducing the need to scale out to larger instances merely for RAM capacity. However, single-core execution speeds and standard memory bandwidth remain average, representing a tradeoff for workloads that do not scale across multiple threads. Given the strong database operation benchmarks and large local NVMe storage, this instance is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise relational databases, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
